issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk: the problem statement UML and textual task description declare messageOnMilk() with no parameters returning a String (e.g. expected return format: "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). The solution repository defines the interface as messageOnMilk(double volume) and the Seal and Goat implementations implement messageOnMilk(double) returning strings that include the volume (e.g. "Goat Name is milked (0.5L)"). Meanwhile the example usages in Main.java (both template and solution) call messageOnMilk() with no arguments. This inconsistency causes compilation errors for the example call sites and will confuse students about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the Milkable API across artifacts. Preferred fix (match problem statement/UML): change the interface to declare String messageOnMilk() with no parameters, and update Seal and Goat to implement messageOnMilk() returning the format "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Ensure all example calls (Main.java in template and solution) call messageOnMilk() with no arguments. Alternatively, if a milk volume is intentional, update the problem statement, UML, and template examples to declare and document messageOnMilk(double volume) and update all example usages to pass a volume.
